svg.title: Orca on AWS architecture
svg.desc: A desktop client reaches Orca on EC2 through a Systems Manager port forward. A mobile client connects separately over Tailscale. Administrators use Systems Manager. The coding agent calls Bedrock, projects persist on encrypted EBS, and AWS Backup protects the workspace daily.
svg.text: The deployed GPU workstation and its independent client connections
Phone pairs with the EC2 Tailscale address
Dedicated VPC · Zero inbound security group rules
